heading: Contributions in name of another prohibited
lead: No person shall make a contribution in the name of another person or knowingly permit his name to be used to effect such a contribution, and no person shall knowingly accept a contribution made by one person in the name of another person.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 441f of Title 2, The Congress, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 320 of Pub. L. 92–225 was renumbered section 315, and is classified to section 30116 of this title. Another prior section 320 of Pub. L. 92–225 was classified to section 441 of Title 2, The Congress, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 94–283. Another prior section 320 of Pub. L. 92–225 was renumbered section 314, and is classified to section 30115 of this title.
